title: Direct Knowledge Of Allah 19th Degree 1st Truth Proofs Of The 7 Attributes Especially Life

questions.question: Which Divine attribute is said to make Allah known through revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: The attribute of Speech.

questions.question: Which Divine attribute is said to make Allah known through created works and visible effects?
questions.answer: The attribute of Power.

questions.question: How are the works of Power compared to words in the passage?
questions.answer: They are described like outward words that take visible form.

questions.question: What does the whole universe become when looked at through the works of Power?
questions.answer: It becomes like a living book spread across creation.

questions.question: What does that “book” show about Allah?
questions.answer: It points to a Mighty and Glorious Creator.

questions.question: Through what kinds of created things does the attribute of Knowledge make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through wise, orderly, balanced, directed, and beautifully arranged creatures and objects.

questions.question: What idea about Allah is shown by the many well-ordered parts of creation?
questions.answer: They show that one Sacred Being knows and arranges them.

questions.question: Besides its own signs, what other proofs support the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: The signs of Power, the signs of Knowledge, and the proofs of the other attributes.

questions.question: Which created beings are especially named as witnesses to the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: Living beings.

questions.question: What do living beings reflect according to the passage?
questions.answer: They reflect many proofs of Allah’s attributes.

questions.question: What does the passage say the attribute of Life does to the universe?
questions.answer: It keeps renewing and changing it with fresh forms and patterns.

questions.question: Why is the universe compared to a great mirror made of many small mirrors?
questions.answer: Because Life shows Allah’s signs again and again in countless created things.

questions.question: Which other attributes are said to reveal Allah just as the universe does?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: How do the other attributes also point to Life?
questions.answer: Because knowing, hearing, seeing, willing, powerful action with purpose, and speaking all require life.

questions.question: Why is Seeing linked to Life in the passage?
questions.answer: Because seeing belongs only to one who is living.

questions.question: Why is Speech linked to both Knowledge and Life?
questions.answer: Because speaking belongs to one who is alive and knows.

questions.question: What special rank is given to the attribute of Life near the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as a main foundation and support for the other attributes.

questions.question: Why does the passage end briefly instead of giving a full explanation?
questions.answer: Because it says fuller proofs are explained elsewhere, so only a small part is given here.

questions.question: What is one way the passage says Allah is made known by the attribute of Speech?
questions.answer: Through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: What is one way the passage says Allah is made known by the attribute of Power?
questions.answer: Through the skill and effects seen in creation.

questions.question: What comparison helps explain how Power points to Allah?
questions.answer: Created things are compared to meaningful words made visible.

questions.question: If creation is like a book, what does reading it help a person understand?
questions.answer: That it has a powerful and glorious Maker.

questions.question: What qualities in created things are connected to the attribute of Knowledge?
questions.answer: Wisdom, order, balance, direction, beauty, and distinction.

questions.question: Does the passage present Allah’s Knowledge as scattered among many beings or belonging to one Sacred Essence?
questions.answer: It presents it as belonging to one Sacred Essence.

questions.question: What makes the proof of Life stronger than only its own direct signs?
questions.answer: The other Divine attributes also support and confirm it.

questions.question: Which two attributes are mentioned first as helping prove Life?
questions.answer: Power and Knowledge.

questions.question: Why are living creatures important in the argument about Life?
questions.answer: Because they act like witnesses reflecting many signs of Allah.

questions.question: What ongoing action in the universe is connected to the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: Constant renewal and change with new designs.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest by saying the universe is made of many mirrors?
questions.answer: Allah’s signs appear in countless different beings.

questions.question: Name four attributes, besides Life, that are said to reveal the Most Sacred Essence.
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: What conclusion can be drawn from the statement that knowledge is a sign of life?
questions.answer: If there is true knowledge, it points to a living possessor of that knowledge.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect purposeful power with living beings?
questions.answer: Because acting with purpose belongs to one who has life.

questions.question: How does the passage use everyday reasoning to support belief in Divine Life?
questions.answer: It shows that abilities like hearing, seeing, willing, and speaking belong to the living.

questions.question: What strong claim is made about the number of proofs for Life?
questions.answer: That its proofs are far more numerous than the universe itself in a figurative, emphatic way.

questions.question: What role does Life have in relation to the other attributes?
questions.answer: It is their base, source, and support.

questions.question: What does the final sentence suggest about the material just given?
questions.answer: It is only a small sample of a much larger explanation.

questions.question: In the passage, which attribute introduces Allah through messages given to creation?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute introduces Allah through the design and effects seen in the world?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: Why are created effects compared to spoken or written expressions?
questions.answer: Because they carry meaning and point to the One who produced them.

questions.question: What image is used for the whole cosmos in the discussion of Power?
questions.answer: A complete book full of meaning.

questions.question: What can a believer understand from this image of the cosmos?
questions.answer: That the world points to a majestic and mighty Creator.

questions.question: What features of creation show the attribute of Knowledge?
questions.answer: Their careful order, wisdom, balance, management, beauty, and distinctness.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the relation between creatures and Allah’s Knowledge?
questions.answer: Creatures are arranged and marked out by Allah’s Knowledge.

questions.question: Is Life proven in the passage by one line of evidence or by many?
questions.answer: By many lines of evidence.

questions.question: What are some of those lines of evidence for Life?
questions.answer: Its own signs, the works showing Power, the forms showing Knowledge, and the proofs of the other attributes.

questions.question: What special witness group is called to testify to Life?
questions.answer: All living beings.

questions.question: What does the phrase about an Eternally Living and Self-Subsistent Essence teach?
questions.answer: That Allah’s life is everlasting and does not depend on anything else.

questions.question: How does continual change in the universe support the discussion of Life?
questions.answer: It shows ongoing renewal, fresh patterns, and active display.

questions.question: Why might the passage call the cosmos a “supreme mirror”?
questions.answer: Because it reflects Divine signs in a grand and wide-reaching way.

questions.question: Which paired attributes are mentioned together after the discussion of Life?
questions.answer: Seeing and Hearing, Willing and Speaking.

questions.question: What shared lesson do those attributes teach?
questions.answer: They all reveal the Most Sacred Essence.

questions.question: How does the passage argue from the attributes back to Life?
questions.answer: It says those qualities cannot belong except to one who is living.

questions.question: Why does Will point to Life?
questions.answer: Because choosing belongs only to a living being.

questions.question: What main conclusion about Life is reached near the end?
questions.answer: It is central among the attributes and strongly proves the One it belongs to.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes Allah known through revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: The attribute of Speech.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes Allah known through skilled creation?
questions.answer: The attribute of Power.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying effects are like words with outer form?
questions.answer: Created things express meaning and show their Maker in a visible way.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give of the cosmos under the aspect of Power?
questions.answer: It is like a meaningful book spread from one end to the other.

questions.question: What truth does this picture help a reader understand?
questions.answer: That creation points to a Lord of great power and glory.

questions.question: Through what signs does the attribute of Knowledge become known?
questions.answer: Through the wisdom, order, balance, direction, and beauty found in creation.

questions.question: What does the passage show about the relationship between order and knowledge?
questions.answer: Deep order points to true knowledge behind it.

questions.question: What three broad kinds of proofs are named for the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: Its own evidences, the signs of Power, and the signs of Knowledge, along with the rest of the attributes.

questions.question: Who serve as mirrors for the many proofs connected to Life?
questions.answer: Living creatures.

questions.question: What do those living creatures help make known?
questions.answer: An Ever-Living and Self-Subsisting Lord.

questions.question: What effect does the attribute of Life have on the universe over time?
questions.answer: It keeps it in motion through constant renewal and fresh displays.

questions.question: Why are many smaller mirrors mentioned?
questions.answer: To show that countless beings reflect Divine signs in their own ways.

questions.question: Which attributes are listed as also revealing Allah after Life is explained?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: What argument is made from Hearing and Seeing to Life?
questions.answer: Those abilities belong only to a living being.

questions.question: What argument is made from Speech to Life?
questions.answer: Speaking requires both life and knowledge.

questions.question: How does the passage connect purposeful use of power to livingness?
questions.answer: It says purposeful power is only found in those that have life.

questions.question: Why is Life described as the foundation of the attributes?
questions.answer: Because the other attributes point back to it and depend on it in meaning.

questions.question: Why does the writer say only a little is being given here?
questions.answer: Because the fuller explanation exists elsewhere, and this is just a small portion.

questions.question: Which attribute is linked with revelation and inspiration in the passage?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute is linked with works, design, and effects in creation?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: What lesson comes from comparing created things to outward words?
questions.answer: They communicate the existence of the One who made them.

questions.question: How is the universe described when viewed through the attribute of Power?
questions.answer: Like a great book full of meaning.

questions.question: What does that description encourage a person to recognize?
questions.answer: A glorious and powerful Creator.

questions.question: Which qualities in creation point to the attribute of Knowledge?
questions.answer: Their wisdom, order, balance, arrangement, beauty, and distinct features.

questions.question: What does the passage emphasize by saying each created thing is administered and adorned through Knowledge?
questions.answer: Nothing is random; it is all knowingly arranged.

questions.question: Does the proof for Life stand alone, or is it supported by other proofs too?
questions.answer: It is supported by many other proofs too.

questions.question: What kinds of things support the proof of Life?
questions.answer: Works showing Power, forms showing Knowledge, and signs from the other attributes.

questions.question: Why are animate beings especially important in this discussion?
questions.answer: Because they are living witnesses that reflect many Divine signs.

questions.question: What two qualities of the Divine Essence are highlighted through the proof of Life?
questions.answer: Ever-livingness and self-subsistence.

questions.question: How does constant change in the cosmos relate to Life?
questions.answer: It shows Life bringing new forms and displays again and again.

questions.question: What is the benefit of the mirror image used for the universe?
questions.answer: It helps explain how many beings reflect one Lord’s attributes.

questions.question: Which four attributes are named after the discussion of the renewing universe?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: What do these four attributes have in common in the passage?
questions.answer: Each helps reveal the Most Sacred Essence.

questions.question: Why does the passage say knowing points to life?
questions.answer: Because knowledge is a mark of a living possessor.

questions.question: Why does the passage say will points to life?
questions.answer: Because choosing happens only with life.

questions.question: What final conclusion is made about the place of Life among the attributes?
questions.answer: It is a basic source and support for the others, with very many proofs.

questions.question: What Divine attribute is mentioned first in the target passage?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: What does the passage say Speech does?
questions.answer: It makes Allah known through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: Which attribute is presented next as another way Allah is made known?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: Through what does Power make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through skillful works and their results in creation.

questions.question: What comparison is used to explain those works?
questions.answer: They are like meaningful words that can be seen.

questions.question: What larger image is then used for the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: A book stretching across the universe.

questions.question: Who is made known by that cosmic book?
questions.answer: A Possessor of might and glory.

questions.question: What does the attribute of Knowledge show through created things?
questions.answer: That one Sacred Essence knows, directs, and beautifies them.

questions.question: What details in creation help point to Knowledge?
questions.answer: Their wisdom, order, balance, guidance, beauty, and uniqueness.

questions.question: How is the attribute of Life proven in more than one way?
questions.answer: By its own signs and by the signs of Power, Knowledge, and the other attributes.

questions.question: What role do living beings play in proving Life?
questions.answer: They serve as witnesses and mirrors for many proofs.

questions.question: What kind of Divine Essence do these witnesses make known?
questions.answer: One that is eternally alive and needs nothing to keep existing.

questions.question: What does Life do in the cosmos according to the passage?
questions.answer: It keeps renewing it with changing forms and fresh patterns.

questions.question: Why does the passage speak of countless mirrors?
questions.answer: To show that many creatures reflect Divine signs in many ways.

questions.question: Which attributes are said to reveal Allah in a way similar to the cosmos?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: How does the passage use simple reasoning to connect these attributes to Life?
questions.answer: It explains that such qualities belong only to one who is living.

questions.question: Which attribute is said to require both life and knowledge?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: What is the overall importance of Life in this passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as a central attribute with extremely many proofs and as a support for the other attributes.
